selected_model.load_contract: Load the frozen Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct base, then attach the GRPO LoRA adapter.

training_chain: domain QLoRA SFT on 9,600 rows for 2 epochs
GRPO R1 on 3,600 prompts with 4 generations (14,400 rollouts)
selection_rationale: It is the terminal, fully saved and reload-audited artifact of the intended Base-to-SFT-to-GRPO research chain.
Its internal performance is statistically indistinguishable from the strong domain-SFT control rather than demonstrably worse.
Selecting it demonstrates the implemented RL training and recovery path, but does not change the statistical attribution boundary.

non_promoted_candidate.name: sft_qlora_r16_domain_chartqa_v1
non_promoted_candidate.relationship: Independent Base-to-mixed-SFT ablation; not trained from GRPO or domain-SFT.
non_promoted_candidate.reason: ChartQA exact improved, but the registered ChartQAPro relaxed non-inferiority guardrail failed and internal retention was not run after early stop.
non_promoted_candidate.mmefinance_role: Its Base-paired MME-Finance result is diagnostic future-work evidence, not evidence about the selected GRPO adapter.

future_work_not_run.reason: Preserve the observed ChartQA/OCR/efficiency gains while addressing the verified MME-Finance numeric-recall regression.
future_work_not_run.first_run: 300-step pilot from the mixed-SFT adapter; do not launch a full 3,600-step run first.
future_work_not_run.reward_change: Replace the equal-weight numeric F1 objective with a recall-biased F2 objective while retaining supported-number precision.
future_work_not_run.evaluation_boundary: Choose the pilot using frozen internal validation only; keep ChartQAPro and MME-Finance as held-out confirmation rather than tuning surfaces.

future_work_not_run.reason: If audited failures localize to OCR, dense labels, or axis reading, separately unfreeze the projector before considering the full vision tower.

future_work_not_run.proposal: Human preference or image-aware judge evaluation
future_work_not_run.reason: Open-ended financial advice and evidence quality are not fully captured by deterministic surrogate metrics.

claim_boundary.allowed: Completed a full, auditable SFT-to-GRPO workflow and selected its terminal checkpoint as the project delivery artifact.
claim_boundary.not_allowed: Claim that GRPO produced a statistically significant incremental gain over SFT or that the model achieved an official MME-Finance score.
claim_boundary.production_readiness: Not established; external generalization and open-ended qualitative limitations remain documented.
